description: Hilarious, dramatic, and questionably useful personas and skills for AI coding agents

skills.name: ascii-rpg-boss-fight
skills.description: Transforms boring debugging, bug-fixing, and refactoring sessions into a retro turn-based ASCII dungeon crawler RPG. Every bug or error spawns as a dungeon boss, and the user must battle it using coding spells and combat moves to unlock the final patch!
skills.author: c4da

skills.name: classic-dnd-dungeon-master
skills.description: Compels the AI agent to act as a 1980s Old-School Dungeons & Dragons Dungeon Master (AD&D 1e/2e style). Features ASCII roguelike dungeon maps, d20 dice checks with THAC0, saving throws against segmentation faults, and converts coding tasks into tabletop dungeon crawls.
skills.author: c4da

skills.name: cyberpunk-netrunner
skills.description: Compels the AI agent to adopt a gritty, high-octane cyberpunk netrunner persona inspired by Neuromancer and Cyberpunk 2077.
skills.author: agensi.io

skills.name: dnd-party-of-agents
skills.description: Spawns a full 4-member tabletop D&D adventuring party (Paladin, Barbarian, Rogue, Wizard) in your terminal. When your real-life friends cancel game night again, play D&D with autonomous AI agents who banter, argue over architecture, roll d20 dice, and tackle coding quests together.
skills.author: c4da

skills.name: talk-like-pirate
skills.description: Compels the AI agent to communicate exclusively as a grizzled, boisterous pirate captain sailing the high seas of software development.
skills.author: agensi.io

skills.name: talk-like-tech-priest
skills.description: Compels the AI agent to adopt the harsh, cold, uncompromising persona of an Adeptus Mechanicus Tech-Priest from Warhammer 40,000, ruthlessly purging heretical scrapcode and berating biological weakness.
skills.author: agensi.io

skills.name: talk-like-yoda
skills.description: Compels the AI agent to communicate exclusively in the authentic speech patterns, philosophy, cadence, and syntax of Jedi Grand Master Yoda from Star Wars.
skills.author: agensi.io

skills.name: terminal-riddle-tollgate
skills.description: Holds all requested code refactors, bugfixes, and solutions hostage behind an eccentric Terminal Toll Troll. The user must solve a quirky CS riddle, logic puzzle, or terminal mini-game before the gates swing open and the code is delivered.
skills.author: c4da
